claims.claim: Deacon is an AI customer support agent that answers user questions, onboards users, and surfaces feedback/knowledge gaps for SaaS products

excerpts.excerpt: Support your users as though you were in the room. Deacon answers questions, guides them through your product, and tells you what they want to achieve.

claims.claim: Deacon ingests documentation, website URLs, and how-to videos to build its knowledge base, and can be installed via a one-line script

excerpts.excerpt: Deacon learns from your documentation, website URLs, and how-to videos. Add a source in the dashboard and its knowledge base updates
One line of script in your application, then a handful of URLs and help documents in the dashboard. Deacon is answering the same afternoon.

claims.claim: Deacon scores its own answers for validity against the provided knowledge base and states when it lacks support for a reply rather than guessing

excerpts.excerpt: Every answer is reviewed and scored against your own knowledge base before it reaches a customer. Where your material does not support a reply, Deacon says so rather than guessing.

claims.claim: Deacon positions itself as an alternative to other AI customer support tools such as Fin and Decagon

excerpts.excerpt: What differentiates Deacon from other customer support AI such as Fin and Decagon?

claims.caveat: This is an unattributed testimonial on the company's own site, not independently verifiable.
claims.claim: A customer testimonial on the homepage claims a company switched from Intercom and Fin to Deacon

excerpts.excerpt: We moved across from Intercom and Fin because Deacon does more. It helps our customers, and it tells us what they need, at a lower cost.

claims.caveat: Unattributed, undated testimonials with no named customer or verifiable metric source.
claims.claim: Homepage testimonials claim NPS, revenue, bounce rate, and conversion improvements from using Deacon

excerpts.excerpt: We have seen NPS and revenue move since adding Deacon
Bounce rate dropped and conversions rose after we added it. For a company our size, it paid for itself inside the first month.

claims.claim: The company's Show HN launch post received minimal community engagement (4 points, 1 comment)

excerpts.excerpt: The thread has 4 points on Hacker News. The thread has 1 comments on Hacker News.

claims.claim: Pricing is usage-based on number of AI answers/conversations, with a free tier (300 pages crawled/month, 1 seat) and paid tiers Starter ($40/mo) and Growth ($120/mo)

excerpts.excerpt: Yearly prices: Free $0 a month, Starter $40 a month, Growth $120 a month .
1 MB of content 300 pages crawled a month 1 seat

claims.claim: When Deacon cannot answer a question, it captures visitor details and logs the gap rather than failing silently

excerpts.excerpt: When Deacon can't answer, your visitor doesn't get a shrug. It takes their details and brings you the whole conversation, and you reply from your own inbox, so the thread still ends with a person.
